entries.source: Josef Riedmann, Die Übernahme der Hochstiftsverwaltung in Brixen und Trient durch Beauftragte Kaiser Friedrichs II. im Jahre 1236, Mitteilungen des Instituts für Österreichische Geschichtsforschung 88 (1980); Riedmann, p. 146, citing the notarial imbreviatures of Jakob Haas, series I, entries 593 and following
entries.english: During the latter half of 1237, Reinhard of Rosenbach is documented as assessor and administrative or financial officer acting for Gottschalk of Weineck, who held imperial judicial authority at Bolzano under Frederick II.

facts.content: served as assessor and administrative or financial officer for Gottschalk von Weineck.
facts.subject: Reinhard de Rosenbach

entries.latin: assessor et racionem faciens per dominum Gotescalcum de Winecco
